mission.posting: Hackers stole valuable company data. They have been taken care of, but what they stole still needs to be removed.

email.subject: #CLIENT# - Loose Ends
email.body:
Greetings Agent,
Our company, #CLIENT#, was recently a victim of a hacker attack. The attackers in question have already been brought to justice for their acts, but we were unable to recover the archive they stole. We do, however have the IP Address of their server, and we would like you to take care of this problem for us.
Subtlety would be much appreciated.
-#CLIENT#
